verdict.rationale: Adyen has a review outcome and case management, but the review step is documented only as a human working in the Customer Area UI (docs-9). An agent could see which payments were sent to case management, and which risk rules triggered, through webhooks and the payment response (docs-16). From that it could build its own flagged-case feed and context, then recommend a decision for a human to confirm in the Customer Area. An official MCP server exists (docs-17, probe-4), but nothing shows it exposes case-management or review-queue data. Missing for 10: an API or MCP tool to list and pull review-queue cases with full context, a programmatic way to record or propose an accept/reject recommendation, and evidence the MCP server covers risk cases.
